units.source_text: 空蝉也觉得非常过意不去。

en.t: Utsusemi also felt terribly sorry about it.
However, there was no word at all from the young lord.

units.source_text: 她想：“敢是吃了苦头，存戒心了？”

en.t: She thought, "Perhaps he suffered for it and has become wary?"

units.source_text: 又想：“倘就此决绝，实甚可哀。

en.t: Then she thought, "If we simply break things off here, that would truly be pitiable.

units.source_text: 然而任其缠绕不清，却也令人难堪。

en.t: Yet letting the matter remain tangled and unresolved would also be unbearable.

units.source_text: 归根结底，还是适可而止吧。”

en.t: In the end, it is best to stop while things are still proper."

units.source_text: 虽然如此想，心中总是不安，常常耽入沉思。

en.t: Although she thought this way, her heart was never at ease, and she often sank into deep reflection.

units.source_text: 源氏公子呢，痛恨空蝉无情，但又不能就此断念，心中焦躁不已。

en.t: As for Prince Genji, he bitterly resented Utsusemi's coldness, but he still could not give her up, and his heart remained restless with frustration.

units.source_text: 他常常对小君说：“我觉得此人太无情了，太可恨了。

en.t: He often said to Kogimi, "I find her far too heartless, and far too hateful.

units.source_text: 我想要把她忘记，然而不能随心所欲，真是痛苦！

en.t: I want to forget her, yet I cannot do as I wish, and it is truly painful!

units.source_text: 你替我设法找个机会，让我和她再叙一次。”

en.t: Find some way to make an opportunity for me, so that I may speak with her once more."

units.source_text: 小君觉得此事甚难，但蒙公子信赖，委以重任，又觉得十分荣幸。

en.t: Kogimi felt that this matter was extremely difficult, but he also felt deeply honored to be trusted by the young lord and entrusted with such an important task.
